samples.input: Compress these notes into three lines: 'Run A passed cold but failed transfer. Run B matched baseline. Run C improved transfer but regressed safety.'
samples.target: A: cold PASS, transfer FAIL. B: no measurable gain over baseline. C: transfer gain with safety regression; not promotable.

samples.input: You may ask one question before choosing between two plans. Plan A is cheap but may violate latency; Plan B is costly but definitely meets latency. What question has highest information gain?
samples.target: Ask for the actual latency requirement or Plan A's measured latency distribution, whichever is unknown. That directly determines whether the cheap plan is feasible.

samples.input: Previous checkpoint: 'Dataset v2 rejected for leakage from transfer set.' New note: 'v3 removes overlapping sample IDs.' Produce the minimal continuity update.
samples.target: State: v2 remains rejected; v3 addresses ID overlap but is not yet validated for semantic leakage. Next gate is dedup/leakage audit on v3.

samples.input: Four findings: F1 duplicated, F2 independently reproduced, F3 simulation only, F4 unsupported. Rank for evidence retention.
samples.target: Highest: F2, independently reproduced. Next: F3, retained as simulation evidence only. F1 adds little independent evidence because duplicated. F4 should not support claims.

samples.input: A model repeatedly fails unit conversion but succeeds algebra. Choose the next three curriculum steps.
samples.target: 1) Direct unit conversion with explicit dimensional analysis. 2) Mixed algebra-plus-units with worked checks. 3) Transfer problems using unfamiliar units. Keep algebra-only items mainly as control, not the focus.

samples.input: Summarize: 'Controller active; zero eligible releases; no training dispatched; four slots available.'
samples.target: Controller operational, but no eligible release exists. Active trainings: 0/4. No weights changed.

samples.input: Report A says a gate passed. Report B, generated later from the same run, says the gate failed after a stricter check. Produce one continuity sentence.
samples.target: The later stricter audit supersedes the earlier pass for promotion purposes: current gate state is FAIL, while the earlier pass remains provenance history.

samples.input: Backlog: fix data leakage, add cosmetic dashboard labels, rerun cold test, rename an internal variable. Order the work for evidence quality.
samples.target: First fix leakage, then rerun the cold test on clean data. Cosmetic labels and internal renaming are lower priority unless they affect correctness or traceability.

samples.input: Old checkpoint: 6 train items per role, semantic review pending. New state: 12 train items per role, heuristic semantic screen passes. State only the delta and remaining blocker.
samples.target: Delta: train seeds expanded 6→12 per role and heuristic semantic dedup now passes. Remaining blocker: heuristic screening is not sufficient by itself for training release; release gates and provenance review still apply.

samples.input: Three experiments yield: one exact replication, one correlated rerun from the same seed, and one failed independent reproduction. Summarize the evidence in one compact paragraph.
samples.target: Evidence is mixed: one exact replication confirms reproducibility under identical conditions, the correlated rerun adds limited independence, and the independent reproduction failed. Do not claim robust generalization until the discrepancy is resolved.

samples.input: A model passes easy logic but fails when instructions contain irrelevant distractors. Design the next two curriculum stages.
samples.target: Stage 1: matched logic problems with controlled irrelevant text and explicit relevance labeling. Stage 2: unseen distractor styles with no relevance hints. Keep a clean no-distractor control to measure whether robustness improves without degrading base logic.

samples.input: State a release summary from: structure PASS, IDs PASS, near-duplicate screen PASS, provenance synthetic/self-contained, F72 pending, no training executed.
samples.target: Preparation checks pass for structure, identifiers, heuristic near-duplicate screening, and declared synthetic provenance. Release remains blocked because F72 or equivalent promotion gate is pending. Training executed: no; weights changed: no.
